title: Forms
saved: Draft saved. The accepting version is unchanged.
signInHint: Sign in with a verified account.
accessChanged: Access could not be confirmed. Actions have stopped without sending your draft.
accountChanged: The account changed. Actions on this screen have stopped.
conflict: Settings or the accepting version changed. Your input is retained. Reload and review.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Retry with the same request ID and answers.
managerUncertain: The save result could not be confirmed. Your draft is retained and changes are paused. Reload and review.
unavailable: The request could not be completed. Your input is retained.
invalidResponse: The response could not be verified. Your input is retained and changes are paused.
invalidValue: Check the entered values. No changes were saved.
tooLarge: The input exceeds the supported size.
rateLimited: The submission limit was reached. Your input and request ID are retained. Retry later.
question: Question {number}
noSupportedProperties: No supported properties. Add properties to the collection first.
previewHint: This preview does not submit. Choose answers to preview conditional questions.
needsRepublish: Review required after schema or access changes
copied: Response link copied. Only assigned verified respondents can use it.
boundary: Choose assigned verified accounts or anyone with an anonymous link. Submitting grants no access to the destination or other responses. File, person and relation questions are not supported.
requiredProperties: Include every required collection property as an unconditional question. Collection schema changes require acceptance review.
publicationHint: Save the draft before starting a new version. Previous responses retain their question labels and version.
recipientHint: Up to 16 people. Names are shown only for candidates who can read this page. Add other current members by account ID.
managerConsent: I confirm that I, as the publisher, receive management access to each new response page. Respondents receive no read access.
consentRequired: Confirm management access for new response pages.
acceptedHint: No response read access was granted. Contact the form manager to request a change.
answerHint: This form requires a verified account. Destination records and counts are not shown.
remaining: Responses cannot be edited after submission. Assigned accounts may submit up to 5 new responses per minute and 50 per hour.
publicExposureHint: Anyone with the link can see the form title, description, questions and choices. Response lists and the destination stay private. Publishing a new version changes the link and disables the old one.
publicExposureConsent: I reviewed the preview and agree to publish the questions and choices and accept anonymous responses.
startedPublic: Anonymous acceptance started. You can share the new response link.
publicCopied: Anonymous response link copied. Anyone with the link can respond.
publicAnswerHint: You can respond without logging in. Destination records and other people's responses are not shown.
publicRemaining: The entire form accepts up to 20 attempts per minute and 200 per hour, including invalid input. Submitted responses cannot be edited. IP addresses are not stored.
removeHint: Removing this question resets dependent questions to always shown.
noCollectionManage: You cannot manage forms for this collection.
unsavedStart: Save the draft before starting acceptance.
schemaChanged: The destination properties changed. Review each question’s property mapping.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
